description: A bed with a blue sheet and pink pillow is in front, with a small slipcase holding three paperback books near the right side. The right hand reaches in from the right, grips a blue book and slides it out to the right onto the bed, then returns to pull out a green book and sets it down; next the right hand removes a red book from the slipcase and places it flat on the bed while the left hand stays mostly resting near the bottom edge.
